Kishan @ Krishna @ Sunil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15
December, 2023

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:237395
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 50200 of 2023
Applicant :- Kishan @ Krishna @ Sunil

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Shri Ram Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Bhism Pal Singh and Smt. Gunjan Sharma, learned counsels have filed their powers on behalf
of the informant and High Court Legal Services Committee respectively which are taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Shri Ram Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Bhism Pal Singh, learned counsel for the informant, Smt.Gunjan Sharma, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the High Court Legal Services Committee and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State.

3. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.0291 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Eka, District Firozabad during pendency of the trial.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR, applicant enticed away the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and on the basis of false allegation, he has been made accused in the present matter and in fact marriage of the victim was settled with the applicant by her parents but it appears, some dispute arose between applicant and father of the victim and thereafter applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

6. He further submits that victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. categorically stated that she herself had gone along with the applicant after scolding by her mother but when her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded then she changed her entire version and stated that uncles of her friend sold her to the applicant and, therefore, there are material contradictions in both the statements of the victim.
7. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since13.8.2023.

8. Per contra, learned AGA, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel appearing for the High Court Legal Services Committee opposed the prayerfor bail and submitted that victim is hardly 15-1/2 years old and, therefore, there was no occasion for her parents to settle her marriage with the applicant but they could not dispute the fact that there are material contradictions in both the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
9.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, from the school record of the victim it reflects that she was about 15-1/2 years old but during investigation her ossification test was not conducted and she however in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of rape against the applicant and also stated that uncles of her friend sold her but when her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. was earlier recorded then she did not make any such allegation and categorically stated that when her mother scolded her then she left her paternal home and had gone along with applicant and therefore, I find force in the argument advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant that there are material contradictions in both the statements of the victim.
11.
Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 13.8.2023.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant-Kishan @ Krishna @ Sunil be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
